title: Beds in West Yorkshire: Dewsbury, Huddersfield, Leeds, Wakefield and Bradford
body:
Quick answer: Eagle Bed is a family-run bed maker in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. We make upholstered beds to order in our own workshop and sell them online and by phone. Our own team delivers them free across West Yorkshire, including Huddersfield, Leeds, Wakefield and Bradford, usually within 3 to 5 working days. Optional room-of-choice assembly is available for £69.99 — add it when you order.

Who we are

Eagle Bed is a family-run business that makes fully upholstered beds: panel beds, wingback beds, Chesterfield beds, gas-lift ottoman storage beds, divan beds and kids beds, plus headboards and mattresses. We do not make wooden or metal beds. We are not a reseller: the beds we sell are the beds we make.

Our workshop in Dewsbury

Every bed is made to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury. The frame is built from solid timber with a slatted base, then padded and upholstered by hand in the size, fabric and colour you pick. Because nothing is pulled off a warehouse shelf, the bed that arrives is the one you chose, from Kids Single (2ft6) up to Super King (6ft). You can read more about how a bed is made on our handmade in Dewsbury page.

If you are searching for "beds Dewsbury", "beds made in Yorkshire" or "bespoke beds Yorkshire", this is what you get from us: a bed built locally for your order, delivered by the same small team, with one phone number to call if you need anything afterwards.

How it works

  1. Choose your bed. Browse online and pick a design, size, fabric and colour. Free fabric swatches are available if you want to see colours first.
  2. We make it. Your bed is built and upholstered in Dewsbury.
  3. We deliver it. Our own team brings it to your home. Want it built for you? Add room-of-choice assembly for £69.99. Delivery is free across England, Scotland and Wales and usually takes 3 to 5 working days. Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man cost £90.
  4. You are covered. 14-day free returns and a 5-year frame warranty (mattresses have a 5-year guarantee).

Delivery around West Yorkshire

Beds in Dewsbury

Dewsbury is home: every Eagle Bed is built and upholstered in our workshop here. Orders for Dewsbury addresses go out with our own team like any other order, and room-of-choice assembly is available for £69.99 if you would like it built for you. Order online or call us, and we will ring you to agree a delivery window once the bed is ready.

Beds in Huddersfield

Huddersfield orders are delivered free by our own team, and room-of-choice assembly can be added for £69.99. Delivery is usually within 3 to 5 working days. If you are not sure whether a tall headboard suits your room, call us with the measurements before you order.

Beds in Leeds

We deliver free to Leeds and the surrounding areas, and room-of-choice assembly can be added for £69.99. Most Leeds orders follow the same 3 to 5 working day timescale as the rest of Great Britain. Order online, or phone us if you have a question about sizes, fabrics or access to your bedroom.

Beds in Wakefield

Wakefield customers get the same free delivery by our own team, with optional room-of-choice assembly for £69.99, usually within 3 to 5 working days. If you want to compare colours, order free fabric swatches first and order the bed once you are happy.

Beds in Bradford

Bradford orders are delivered free by our own team, with optional room-of-choice assembly for £69.99, usually within 3 to 5 working days. You can pay by card, PayPal, Klarna or Clearpay at checkout, and Klarna and Clearpay are subject to eligibility.

Beds in Mirfield

Mirfield is a close neighbour of Dewsbury. Delivery is free by our own team, with optional room-of-choice assembly for £69.99, and usually takes 3 to 5 working days, the same as for any address in Great Britain. Order online or by phone.

Browse our beds

  • Upholstered beds: the full range of fabric bed frames
  • Chesterfield beds: deep button-tufted headboards
  • Wingback beds: tall headboards with side wings
  • Panel beds: stitched panel and channel headboards
  • Ottoman storage beds: gas-lift bases with storage underneath
  • Divan beds, including bases with drawers
  • Kids beds
  • Headboards and mattresses

Paying for your bed

You can pay by card, PayPal, Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Klarna and Clearpay are subject to eligibility and the provider's terms. See our finance options page for details.

Frequently asked questions

Is there a bed maker near Dewsbury?

Yes. Eagle Bed is a family-run business that makes upholstered beds to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. You order online or by phone on 07417 439197, and our own team delivers the bed for free, usually within 3 to 5 working days. Optional room-of-choice assembly is available for £69.99.

Where can I buy a bed in West Yorkshire?

You can buy a handmade upholstered bed from Eagle Bed at eaglebed.co.uk or by calling 07417 439197, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. Each bed is made in Dewsbury, and delivery is free to Leeds, Bradford, Wakefield, Huddersfield, Mirfield and the rest of Great Britain.

Do you deliver to Huddersfield, Leeds, Wakefield and Bradford?

Yes. Our own delivery team covers Huddersfield, Leeds, Wakefield, Bradford and every other part of England, Scotland and Wales. Delivery is free and usually takes 3 to 5 working days, and room-of-choice assembly is an optional add-on for £69.99. We contact you first to agree a delivery window.

Who sells handmade upholstered beds in Yorkshire?

Eagle Bed makes and sells handmade upholstered beds in Yorkshire. Our panel, wingback, Chesterfield, ottoman storage, divan and kids beds are built on a solid timber frame and upholstered by hand in our Dewsbury workshop, in the size, fabric and colour you choose.

Where can I buy a Chesterfield bed in Yorkshire?

Eagle Bed makes button-tufted Chesterfield beds in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. You can see the full range in our Chesterfield beds collection at eaglebed.co.uk, order free fabric swatches first, and have the bed delivered free by our own team, with optional room-of-choice assembly for £69.99.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. We send free fabric swatches so you can check the colour in your own room before you order. You can request them on our website or by calling 07417 439197. Every bed also has 14-day free returns and a 5-year frame warranty.

Contact Eagle Bed

Pepproyd Street, Eastborough
Dewsbury WF13 1PA
Phone: 07417 439197 (Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm)
